title: Neural Dual Bounds: Valid-by-Construction JGLP Warm-Starts for MAP and Constrained MAP
abstract: arXiv:2611.19218v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present Neural Dual Bounds, a calibration-free framework that produces deterministic upper bounds for MAP inference in probabilistic graphical models using a single neural-network forward pass. The framework trains a network to output the edge messages of a mini-bucket style upper bound on a given join-graph decomposition in a self-supervised manner by directly minimizing a smooth dual objective. The output of this network can be used at test time to warm-start a standard JGLP optimizer. Across diverse benchmarks, this warm start yields dual gaps that are orders of magnitude tighter than those from zero initialization, with the largest gains in the early-iteration regime. translated_title: 神经对偶界：面向MAP与受约束MAP的构造性有效JGLP热启动方法
translated_abstract: 我们提出了Neural Dual Bounds（神经对偶界），这是一个无需校准的框架，仅需一次神经网络前向传播即可为概率图模型中的MAP推理生成确定性的上界。该框架以自监督的方式训练一个网络，通过直接最小化平滑的对偶目标函数，使其输出给定连接图分解上mini-bucket风格上界的边消息。在测试时，该网络的输出可用于热启动标准的JGLP优化器。在多样化的基准测试中，这种热启动所产生的对偶间隙比零初始化紧了数个数量级，且收益在早期迭代阶段最为显著。我们还将该框架应用于受约束MAP（CMPE）任务：在贝叶斯网络上，结合测试时自适应的神经热启动与自适应基线表现相当；而在网格等基准上则取得了最紧的对偶间隙，比基线紧一到两个数量级。
tldr: 提出Neural Dual Bounds框架，通过单次神经网络前向传播为概率图模型的MAP与受约束MAP推理生成构造性有效的上界，用以热启动JGLP优化器，使对偶间隙比零初始化紧数个数量级。
en_tdlr: Neural Dual Bounds is a calibration-free framework that generates valid-by-construction upper bounds for MAP and constrained MAP inference via a single neural forward pass, serving as JGLP warm-starts that tighten dual gaps by orders of magnitude over zero initialization.
